en.description:
Pocket Volley brings fast, simple and addictive arcade volleyball straight to your wrist.

Jump into quick matches wherever you are, learn the simple controls and try to outplay your opponent with perfectly timed shots, clever positioning and quick reactions.

Easy to pick up, but increasingly challenging as you progress, Pocket Volley features multiple game modes and difficulty levels to unlock. Start against easier opponents, improve your skills and work your way up to tougher challenges.

Think you're good enough? Compete for your best results and climb the online leaderboards to see how you compare with other Pocket Volley players.

FEATURES

• Play directly on Apple Watch
• Fast arcade volleyball matches
• Simple controls designed for quick play
• Multiple game modes
• Unlockable difficulty levels
• Increasingly challenging opponents
• Online leaderboards
• Quick matches perfect for playing anywhere
• Easy to learn, challenging to master

Whether you have a minute to spare or want to chase a new high score, Pocket Volley puts a complete little volleyball challenge on your wrist.
en.releaseNotes:
-Improved ball physics for snappier rallies. 
-Better menu controls and tap accuracy. 
-Three new courts, two new balls, one new player colour added.
en.subtitle: Volleyball on Your Wrist
